verdict.rationale: Sentry is a tracing and monitoring platform, so OTLP ingest and export is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions OpenTelemetry or OTLP. All tracing evidence describes Sentry's own SDKs and auto-instrumentation, and `gen_ai.*` attribute naming alone does not show OTLP send or receive support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format
